rules.message: Lazy branches must pair the behavior's event with `once`: data-hx-trigger="hc:treeexpand once" — without `once` every expand refetches and re-swaps the loaded children.
Target the branch's own group: data-hx-target="find .hc-tree__group" (`find` resolves inside the item).

Swap innerHTML — fill the group, keep the <ul> the behavior observes for busy-clearing and role re-application. (innerHTML is also the htmx default — omitting the attribute is fine; anything else is not)
The lazy branch needs an (empty) <ul class="hc-tree__group"> to swap into — without it there is nothing to target and no busy affordance.
A lazy branch must declare branch-ness with aria-expanded (the server owns the initial value, usually "false") — the behavior only dispatches hc:treeexpand on branches.
